# Bond Proxies Deep Dive Analysis

Report 127 | Published 2024-01-07 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2024-1-7/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/127.json)

Bond proxies, liquidity and reporting rules.

Bitcoin met the explicit two-year directional horizon, and the proposed QT-taper sequence occurred. The utility discussion correctly separates earnings growth from multiple risk. NextEra rose but lagged SPY in the chosen two-year window; Pepsi fell and AWK barely advanced. Reporting-law scope, Saudi membership certainty and the NEE/NEP business description require correction or qualification. The decade return forecast remains open.

**Coverage:** All numbered source blocks and chart labels read. All material macro, digital-asset and investment theses are reviewed. Routine holdings lists, incidental statistics and boilerplate are excluded. Chart pixels were not inspected.

## Framework lessons

- Stress-test income assets against refinancing and valuation changes.

## Verification limitations

- Retrieved November 7, 2026; the current webpage is not authenticated as the original publication-date wording.
- Chart labels were read but pixels and proprietary indicator vintages were not inspected.
- Adjusted-close evidence is a vendor proxy for reinvested distributions and splits, in USD without fees or taxes. It does not reconstruct actual portfolio trades. Chosen sensitivity windows are not author deadlines. Macro series use latest vintages.
